notes.list_status: Certified, as re-checked on 2026-10-13. On 2026-08-24 the page was still headed 'List of Uncertified Candidates' and still read 'The nomination period is open until August 21 at 2 p.m.', so the list collected that day was the uncertified one. The page is now headed 'Certified Candidates', reads 'The nomination period for the 2026 City of Peterborough Municipal and School Board election has closed.' and links the Clerk's signed Form EL07, 'List Of Certified Candidates'. Every name and every count survives certification unchanged - 7 mayoral, and 5, 6, 5, 4 and 8 in Wards 1 to 5 - and the EL07 certifies the same 35 under the same six offices. The EL07 is a scan whose text layer is garbled ('Kevin Dur1uay', 'Jacob Methot'), so it was checked by eye rather than parsed; the scan itself prints 'Jacob Méthot', as the page does.
notes.source_note: The layout changed since 2026-08-11: candidates are now paragraphs of the form 'Name: contact details' under an office heading, not table rows.
notes.structure_match: Five wards published - Ward 1 - Otonabee, Ward 2 - Monaghan, Ward 3 - Town, Ward 4 - Ashburnham, Ward 5 - Northcrest - matching the districts listed in the structure CSV (5 districts, 2 seats each, vote-for-2), which names them without their numbers.
notes.ward_labels: The districts here are the page's own headings, 'Councillor, Ward 1 - Otonabee' and so on, which it repeats over its election-day voting places. Collected 2026-08-24 as the name half alone ('Otonabee'); the numbers were restored 2026-08-27 from the same page.
notes.position: From the page's headings, 'Office of Mayor' and 'Councillor, Ward 1 - Otonabee'. 'Office of' frames the race rather than naming the position.
notes.withdrawals: Two Ward 1 candidates are marked 'Withdrawn' and are excluded here: Jessica Correa and Noella Koshul. The page's other three withdrawals are school board trustees.
